title: synchronized-lease-retry-and-pullstream-ergonomics-for-trio-sdks
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Users reported sporadic stream stalls and credential churn during long-lived pullstream usage across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. This PR introduces a synchronized lease model (lease handshake + jittered renewal), aligns retry-window presets across the trio of SDKs, and polishes pullstream ergonomics so that reconnects, cancellations, and backpressure are consistent and easy to reason about. Summary of changes: - Introduce SessionLease abstraction: a lightweight cross-language contract describing lease duration, renew endpoint hints, and advisory heartbeat intervals. The implementation is scoped to SDK clients (no server changes). - Adaptive retry profiles: conservative/standard/aggressive presets that map to the platform's recommended backoff curves. Exposed as named configs on each SDK so users can opt into predictable semantics. - Pullstream ergonomics: add explicit pause()/resume() helpers (TS/Go), optional keepalive heartbeats (Py), and a deterministic close sequence to ensure in-progress chunks are drained before finalizing. - Token prefetch + lease-aware refresh: SDKs now prefetch a replacement credential when the lease is within a configurable threshold to avoid mid-stream auth failures. - Cross-sdk docs and example updates for long-running transcription/agent sessions. Commits (high-level): - Add SessionLease type and TypeScript runtime adapter - Implement lease renew prefetch + metrics ping in Python SDK - Add Go lease-guard to connector and integrate into stream pool - Expose retry presets and mapping table in all SDKs - Tests: add integration-style flakiness test harness and unit tests for backoff transitions Changed files (high-level): - sdks/typescript/src/session/lease.ts - sdks/typescript/src/stream/pullstream.ts - sdks/python/redwood/session/lease.py - sdks/python/redwood/stream/pullstream.py - sdks/go/session/lease.go - sdks/go/stream/pullstream.go - docs/sdk/long-running-sessions.md - examples/multi-region-transcribe/README.md - tests/integration/lease_renew_simulator.py - ci/workflows/sdk-integration.yml Notes on behavior changes: - Default behavior is backwards-compatible: existing clients keep prior semantics. New features are opt-in via the named retry profile or session_lease: {enabled: true}. - The prefetch window defaults to 30s; configurable via client options. - Retry presets are documented with expected P99 retry latencies and recommended workloads. Review conversation highlights: - Rishi: "Nice consolidation — can we reduce the default prefetch window to 15s for low-memory devices?" — Reply (Ava): "Made the prefetch window configurable and dropped default to 15s on the TypeScript client; Python and Go kept 30s due to GC/connection behavior. Added a follow-up task to evaluate lowering across the board (ENG-1430)." - Maya: "Tests look good, but add an assertion that canceled streams don't attempt to renew leases." — Reply (Ava): "Added test cancel_does_not_renew in Python and TS; Go unit uses a mock clock to assert renew suppression." - Noah: "We should expose metrics for lease_renew_attempts and lease_renew_latency." — Reply (Ava): "Added counters and histograms to SDK telemetry wrappers; documented the new metrics in SDK observability section." CI summary: - Linux build (TS/Go/Py): pass - Lint (TS): pass after one fixup commit - Unit tests: pass (flake fixed in 2nd run) - Integration harness: pass (simulator-based) Migration / release notes: "Introduces opt-in SessionLease and named retry presets. Default client behavior unchanged. Recommended for long-running stream users (agents, transcription). See docs/sdk/long-running-sessions.md for migration steps and examples." Release notes bullet: "SDK: opt-in SessionLease for smoother long-lived streams; new retry presets and ergonomic pullstream helpers (pause/resume, graceful close)." Rollout & follow-ups: - Post-merge task to evaluate lowering Python/Go prefetch window (ENG-1430) - Backport to release/1.5.x for TS SDK (tracked separately) Merge: squash and merge.

migration_notes: To opt into SessionLease set client option session_lease.enabled=true and choose a retry preset (conservative/standard/aggressive). See docs/sdk/long-running-sessions.md for example code snippets across TS/Py/Go. If your workloads are memory constrained, reduce prefetch_window_seconds in client options.
release_notes: SDK: opt-in SessionLease for long-lived streams; named retry presets; pause/resume + graceful close helpers; telemetry for lease renews. Backports planned for TS 1.5.x branch.
notes_for_release_manager: This is a tri-sdk feature flag safe change. Recommend coordinated minor bumps for TS/Py/Go packages in the same release window to avoid confusion in examples. Watch lease_renew_attempts metric post-rollout for unexpected spikes.
